item.description:
Added

  • Explorer updates itself now. Choose "Check for Updates…" from the Explorer menu and, if a newer version is out, Explorer downloads it, verifies its signature, replaces itself, and relaunches — no more re-downloading from the website. Turn on automatic checking to be told about new versions as they ship; Explorer only ever downloads an update after you agree to install it, and it never interrupts a copy or move that's in progress. This is free for everyone.
  • A nudge to install into Applications. If you run Explorer straight from the disk image (where updates can't work), it now offers to move itself into your Applications folder in one click.
